title: BUG: Smith's reveal with Hatchling out — P1 first looks at 'top' and recycles it; the reveal then hits the gear underneath, which Smith draws

repro.testName: BUG: Smith's reveal with Hatchling out — P1 first looks at 'top' and recycles it; the reveal then hits the gear underneath, which Smith draws

history.note: Needs a new engine capability: no 'reveal' replacement is ever consulted. Requires (a) handle_reveal (effects/reveal.ts) to scan board cards for abilities {type:'replacement',replaces:'reveal'} whose CONTROLLER is the deck's revealer (ctx.playerId, or each opponent for from=='opponent-decks'), (b) a per-invocation 'already looked' marker carried on the re-entered effect object so two Hatchlings prompt twice and one prompts once, (c) a pendingChoice {type:'confirm'} (yes/no; effect=recycle top card to bottom, then=the original reveal effect re-run) so the look is private+optional and the reveal sees the post-recycle top. 5 test.failing cases; too large and too cross-cutting for one lane without breaking Blind Fury / Apprentice Smith / Dazzling Aurora reveal paths.
